metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the morning with the uncles, the bill of Hercules, the tiring-house, and the sentence under Of Kings.

yesterday: Easter term is open. It runs to the second of June. The yard was thin, and the cause named in the room was a new play over the water.
Nobody swore a height, spoke a receipt, or announced a second part. Blackwage and Hoope are ten shillings the week, and that was the number in the room.
The night page says: They have Hercules. I have a man who talks. Make the talking the labour.
